name: Five-act structure
description: Delicate dramaturgy for complex conflicts and consequences.

acts.title: Act 1: Introduction
acts.description: The initial situation and conflict are set.

beats.title: Exposure
beats.description: World, characters and tensions are introduced.
guidingQuestions: What order prevails at the beginning?

beats.title: trigger
beats.description: The central conflict is set in motion.
guidingQuestions: Who has to react to this?

acts.title: Act 2: Rising action
acts.description: Actions and counteractions exacerbate the conflict.

beats.title: involvement
beats.description: The first plan creates new difficulties.

beats.title: escalation
guidingQuestions: Which options are no longer available?

acts.title: Act 3: Central twist
acts.description: The conflict reaches a climax or decisive reversal.

beats.title: Central revelation
beats.description: A truth changes the meaning of what has happened so far.
guidingQuestions: Who will recognize the truth first?

beats.title: Central highlight
beats.description: The forces meet in a preliminary decision.

acts.title: Act 4: Falling Action
acts.description: The consequences of the turnaround lead to crisis.

beats.title: Consequences
beats.description: Successes and mistakes take their toll.

beats.title: Low point
beats.description: The previous strategy has been exhausted.
guidingQuestions: What inner decision is still missing?

beats.title: Final decision
beats.description: The main character chooses his final path.

beats.title: final
beats.description: The decisive confrontation resolves the main conflict.
guidingQuestions: How is the central theme revealed?
Why can only this exit follow?

beats.title: resolution
beats.description: The new order and open consequences are shown.
